title: conyza saxatilis
intro: Conyza saxatilis, commonly known as fleabane or prickly fleabane, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Conyza saxatilis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various ailments such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, reduce fever, and act as a natural antihistamine. The bioactive constituents of Conyza saxatilis include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
